artists.name: Jackie Brenston and His Delta Cats

podcast.title: Birthplace of Rockabilly Figures
podcast.body: Sun Studios was the pivotal location from which all the major figures of the true rockabilly era emerged. Its distinctive sound set the standard by which aficionados would classify other artists as rockabilly or not. "All the major figures to come out of sun studios have done so."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Historic Recording Location for "Rocket 88"
podcast.body: Sun Studios in Memphis was the location where Jackie Brenston and his Delta Cats recorded "Rocket 88" on March 2nd, 1951. This session, overseen by producer Sam Phillips, is historically significant as it potentially yielded the first rock and roll record due to an accidental bass distortion. "they started on the 75 mile drive north to Sun Studios in Memphis along Highway 61."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
